# TRIHEX DIGITAL
> Nepal-first digital storefront for AI and digital tools (NPR pricing, website checkout, WhatsApp support).

## Site
- Home: https://trihexdigital.shop/
- Products: https://trihexdigital.shop/products
- Blog: https://trihexdigital.shop/blog
- AI tools Nepal: https://trihexdigital.shop/ai-tools-nepal
- Contact / WhatsApp: +977 9702910130

## Ordering
1. Choose an Available product
2. Checkout on the website
3. Pay via bank QR / eSewa / Khalti
4. Upload payment screenshot
5. Message WhatsApp for verification
6. Receive fulfillment after payment confirmation

- Independent retailer — brand names belong to their owners
